name: peer_comparison
description: Identifies peer companies in the same industry and retrieves comparative financial metrics. Use this tool for competitive analysis, relative valuation, or industry benchmarking. Returns a peer comparison matrix with rankings across financial metrics.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol of the target company

num_peers.description: Number of peer companies to compare (default 5)

metrics.description: List of metrics to compare (e.g., 'market_cap', 'pe_ratio', 'revenue_growth', 'profit_margin', 'roe'). Defaults to standard set.
